scripts.summary: Auto Player for Symphony Ochestra.
scripts.code:
if _G.__SYMPHONY_AP then
    local old = _G.__SYMPHONY_AP
    old.alive = false
    pcall(function() old.conn:Disconnect() end)
    pcall(function() old.win:Destroy() end)
    _G.__SYMPHONY_AP = nil
end

local Players = game:GetService('Players')
local RunService = game:GetService('RunService')
local LP = Players.LocalPlayer

local state = { alive = true, enabled = false, lastNote = {} }
_G.__SYMPHONY_AP = state

local function upsOf(f)
    local ok, ups = pcall(getupvalues, f)
    if not ok or type(ups) ~= 'table' then return nil end
    return ups
end

local engine, resolveErr = nil, nil
do
    local function isKeymap(t)
        for k in pairs(t) do
            return typeof(k) == 'EnumItem'
        end
        return false
    end

    local function validateLaneDown(f)
        if type(f) ~= 'function' then return nil end
        local ld = upsOf(f)
        if not ld or #ld < 13 then return nil end
        local Config = ld[8]
        if type(Config) ~= 'table' then return nil end
        if type(rawget(Config, 'PerfectWindow')) ~= 'number' then return nil end
        if type(rawget(Config, 'DefaultLaneKeys')) ~= 'table' then return nil end
        if type(ld[4]) ~= 'number' or type(ld[7]) ~= 'number' then return nil end
        if type(ld[10]) ~= 'table' or type(ld[2]) ~= 'table' then return nil end
        if type(ld[11]) ~= 'number' or type(ld[12]) ~= 'function' then return nil end
        return { laneDown = f, Config = Config, held = ld[2] }
    end

    local ok, res = pcall(function()
        local conns = getconnections(LP:GetAttributeChangedSignal('OrchestraPadKeys'))
        local found = nil
        for _, c in ipairs(conns) do
            if found then break end
            local u = upsOf(c.Function)
            if u and type(u[1]) == 'function' and type(u[2]) == 'boolean' and type(u[3]) == 'function' then
                local bl = upsOf(u[3])
                if bl then
                    for i = 1, #bl do
                        if found then break end
                        if type(bl[i]) == 'function' then
                            local ola = upsOf(bl[i])
                            if ola then
                                for j = 1, #ola do
                                    if found then break end
                                    if type(ola[j]) == 'function' then
                                        local hit = validateLaneDown(ola[j])
                                        if hit then
                                            local keymap
                                            for k = 1, #ola do
                                                if type(ola[k]) == 'table' and isKeymap(ola[k]) then
                                                    keymap = ola[k]
                                                end
                                            end
                                            if keymap then
                                                hit.onLaneAction = bl[i]
                                                hit.keymap = keymap
                                                found = hit
                                            end
                                        end
                                    end
                                end
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
        end
        assert(found, 'RhythmClient lane engine not found')
        return found
    end)
    if ok then engine = res else resolveErr = tostring(res) end
end
state.engine = engine

local function pressLane(lane)
    local Config = engine.Config
    local keymap = engine.keymap
    local key = Config.LaneKeys and Config.LaneKeys[lane]
    if not (key and keymap[key] == lane) then
        key = nil
        for k, v in pairs(keymap) do
            if v == lane then key = k break end
        end
    end
    if not key then return false end
    return pcall(engine.onLaneAction, nil, Enum.UserInputState.Begin, { KeyCode = key })
end

if engine then
    state.conn = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
        if not state.alive then return end
        if not state.enabled then return end

        local ld = upsOf(engine.laneDown)
        if not ld then return end
        local clockOff, songStart, notes = ld[4], ld[7], ld[10]
        if type(clockOff) ~= 'number' or type(songStart) ~= 'number' or type(notes) ~= 'table' then return end
        local n = #notes
        if n == 0 then return end

        local Config = engine.Config
        local audioOff = (Config.AudioOffset or 0) + (LP:GetAttribute('OrchestraAudioOffset') or 0) / 1000
        local pos = (os.clock() + clockOff) - songStart - audioOff

        local goodWindow = (type(ld[11]) == 'number' and ld[11]) or (Config.GoodWindow or 0.12)
        local horizon = goodWindow + (Config.LateGrace or 0.05) - 0.02

        for i = 1, n do
            local note = notes[i]
            if type(note) == 'table' and not note.Judged then
                local t = note.Time
                if type(t) == 'number' then
                    local dt = pos - t
                    if dt >= 0 and dt <= horizon then
                        local lane = note.Lane
                        if type(lane) == 'number' and lane >= 1 and lane <= 4 then
                            if pressLane(lane) then
                                state.lastNote[lane] = { t = t, len = tonumber(note.Length) or 0 }
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
        end

        for lane, info in pairs(state.lastNote) do
            if pos > info.t + info.len + 0.06 then
                engine.held[lane] = nil
                state.lastNote[lane] = nil
            end
        end
    end)
    print('[SymphonyAP] engine hooked: laneDown/onLaneAction/note-list online')
else
    warn('[SymphonyAP] engine hook FAILED: ' .. tostring(resolveErr))
end

local function setEnabled(v)
    state.enabled = v
    if not v then state.lastNote = {} end
end

local function fallbackGui()
    local gui = Instance.new('ScreenGui')
    gui.Name = 'SymphonyAutoplay'
    gui.ResetOnSpawn = false
    gui.Parent = LP:WaitForChild('PlayerGui')
    local btn = Instance.new('TextButton')
    btn.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(150, 40)
    btn.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -75, 0, 8)
    btn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(40, 40, 48)
    btn.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
    btn.TextSize = 16
    btn.Font = Enum.Font.GothamMedium
    btn.Text = 'Autoplay: OFF'
    btn.Parent = gui
    btn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
        setEnabled(not state.enabled)
        btn.Text = 'Autoplay: ' .. (state.enabled and 'ON' or 'OFF')
        btn.BackgroundColor3 = state.enabled and Color3.fromRGB(46, 160, 84) or Color3.fromRGB(40, 40, 48)
    end)
    state.win = { Destroy = function() gui:Destroy() end }
    print('[SymphonyAP] WindUI unavailable, using fallback toggle')
end

local windOk = pcall(function()
    local WindUI = loadstring(game:HttpGet('https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Footagesus/WindUI/main/dist/main.lua'))()
    assert(typeof(WindUI) == 'table' and WindUI.CreateWindow, 'WindUI load failed')

    local Window = WindUI:CreateWindow({
        Title = 'Symphony Autoplay',
        Icon = 'music-note-bold-duotone',
        Folder = 'SymphonyAutoplay',
        OpenButton = { Enabled = true, Title = 'Symphony Autoplay' },
    })
    state.win = Window

    local Tab = Window:Tab({ Title = 'Autoplay', Icon = 'music-note-bold-duotone' })
    Tab:Toggle({
        Title = 'Autoplay Notes',
        Desc = 'Hits every note perfectly - holds included. Start any song and watch it play itself.',
        Default = false,
        Callback = function(v)
            setEnabled(v)
            WindUI:Notify({
                Title = 'Symphony Autoplay',
                Content = v and 'Enabled - start or keep playing a song.' or 'Disabled.',
                Icon = 'music-note-bold-duotone',
                Duration = 3,
            })
        end,
    })

    WindUI:Notify({
        Title = 'Symphony Autoplay',
        Content = engine and 'Engine hooked - ready to play.' or ('Hook failed: ' .. tostring(resolveErr)),
        Icon = 'music-note-bold-duotone',
        Duration = 5,
    })
    print('[SymphonyAP] WindUI ready')
end)

if not windOk then fallbackGui() end

-- DEFAULT COLORS
-- ONLY TARGETS: Slapples Folder & Slapples Inside It
-- LOBBY: IGNORED | ZERO LAG

-- Services
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local Workspace = game:GetService("Workspace")
local LocalPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer

-- Configuration
local Config = {
    AutoSlapple = false,
}

-- Internal Variables
local slappleRunning = false
local lastTeleportTime = 0
local teleportCooldown = 0.3 -- Fast but no lag

-- ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
-- LOAD UI LIBRARY (DEFAULT COLORS)
-- ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
local Library = loadstring(game:HttpGet('https://gist.githubusercontent.com/MjContiga1/6e2c779299e9bf3d3f9edb5bff97b2fb/raw/29b9f1cc215ad4e583271d1ad229f34c921553a8/Lib%2520ui%2520test.lua'))()

-- Create main window
local window = Library:Window('N0NE HUB - Slap Battles')

-- Create tabs
local mainTab = window:Tab('Main')
local extraTab = window:Tab('Extra')
local settingsTab = window:Tab('Settings')

-- ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
-- PERFECT SLAPPLE FINDER - ONLY SLAPPLES FOLDER
-- ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

-- Find ONLY the Slapples folder (NOTHING ELSE)
local function findSlapplesFolder()
    -- Check workspace directly first
    local folder = Workspace:FindFirstChild("Slapples")
    if folder then return folder end
    
    -- Search workspace children for folder named exactly "Slapples"
    for _, v in ipairs(Workspace:GetChildren()) do
        if v:IsA("Folder") and v.Name == "Slapples" then
            return v
        end
    end
    
    -- Search all descendants as last resort
    for _, v in ipairs(Workspace:GetDescendants()) do
        if v:IsA("Folder") and v.Name == "Slapples" then
            return v
        end
    end
    
    return nil
end

-- Get ONLY slapples from the Slapples folder
local function getSlapplesFromFolder()
    local slapples = {}
    local folder = findSlapplesFolder()
    
    if folder then
        -- ONLY get children from the Slapples folder
        for _, slapple in ipairs(folder:GetChildren()) do
            table.insert(slapples, slapple)
        end
    end
    
    return slapples
end

-- Teleport ONLY slapples from the Slapples folder
local function teleportSlapples()
    local character = LocalPlayer.Character
    if not character then return 0 end
    
    local hrp = character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    if not hrp then return 0 end
    
    -- Anti-lag cooldown
    local currentTime = os.clock()
    if currentTime - lastTeleportTime < teleportCooldown then return 0 end
    lastTeleportTime = currentTime
    
    local teleported = 0
    local slapples = getSlapplesFromFolder()
    
    -- Only teleport max 4 at a time to prevent ANY lag
    local count = 0
    for _, slapple in ipairs(slapples) do
        if count >= 4 then break end -- Max 4 per tick
        count = count + 1
        
        pcall(function()
            -- Handle Model type
            if slapple:IsA("Model") then
                local primaryPart = slapple.PrimaryPart or slapple:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") or slapple:FindFirstChild("Part") or slapple:FindFirstChildOfClass("MeshPart")
                if primaryPart then
                    primaryPart.CFrame = hrp.CFrame + Vector3.new(0, 3, 0)
                    teleported = teleported + 1
                end
            -- Handle BasePart type
            elseif slapple:IsA("BasePart") or slapple:IsA("MeshPart") then
                slapple.CFrame = hrp.CFrame + Vector3.new(0, 3, 0)
                teleported = teleported + 1
            end
        end)
    end
    
    return teleported
end

-- ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
-- PERFECT LOOP - NO LAG
-- ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
task.spawn(function()
    while task.wait(0.3) do -- Smooth and fast
        if Config.AutoSlapple and slappleRunning then

            end)
        end

end)

mainTab:Label("🍎 AUTO SLAPPLE (Slapples Folder Only)")

mainTab:Toggle('Auto Teleport Slapples', false, function(state)
    Config.AutoSlapple = state
    slappleRunning = state
    if state then
        print("✅ Auto Slapple ENABLED")
        -- Test immediately
        local count = teleportSlapples()
        print("Found and teleported: " .. count .. " slapples")
    else
        print("❌ Auto Slapple DISABLED")
    end
end)

mainTab:Button('Teleport Slapples Now', function()
    local count = teleportSlapples()
    print("Teleported " .. count .. " slapples!")
end)

mainTab:Button('Check Slapples Folder', function()
    local folder = findSlapplesFolder()
    if folder then
        local slapples = getSlapplesFromFolder()
        print("✅ Found Slapples Folder!")
        print("   Slapples in folder: " .. #slapples)
        for _, slapple in ipairs(slapples) do

-- SETTINGS TAB
-- ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
settingsTab:Label("⚙️ SETTINGS")

settingsTab:Keybind("Toggle UI", Enum.KeyCode.RightShift, function(key)
    print("Key pressed:", key.Name)

end)

settingsTab:Button('Reset All Settings', function()
    Config.AutoSlapple = false
    slappleRunning = false
    print("All settings reset!")
end)

-- ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
-- FINAL NOTIFICATION
-- ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
task.wait(1)
print("✅ N0NE HUB Loaded Successfully!")

local function fetchAndWear(username)
	if username == "" then
		Status.Text = "Please enter a username!"
		return
	end

	if not wearRemote then
		wearRemote = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("Wear", true)
		if not wearRemote then
			Status.Text = "Error: 'Wear' remote not found!"
			return
		end
	end

	Status.Text = "Fetching user ID..."
	local success, userId = pcall(function()
		return Players:GetUserIdFromNameAsync(username)
	end)

	if not success or not userId then
		Status.Text = "User not found!"
		return
	end

	Status.Text = "Fetching avatar assets..."
	local reqFunc = (http and http.request) or request or (syn and syn.request)
	if not reqFunc then
		Status.Text = "Executor does not support http requests!"
		return
	end

	local rawBody = ""
	local res = reqFunc({ Url = "https://avatar.roblox.com/v1/users/" .. userId .. "/avatar", Method = "GET" })
	if type(res) == "table" and res.Body then
		rawBody = res.Body
	elseif type(res) == "string" then
		rawBody = res
	end

	local decOk, data = pcall(function()
		return HttpService:JSONDecode(rawBody)
	end)

	if not decOk or not data or not data.assets then
		Status.Text = "No assets found for this user!"
		return
	end

	Status.Text = "Clearing existing items..."
	pcall(function()
		wearRemote:InvokeServer(0, nil)
	end)
	task.wait(0.5)

	local assetList = data.assets

		BarBack.Position = UDim2.new(0, 10, 0, 26)
		BarBack.Size = UDim2.new(1, -20, 0, 8)
		BarBack.BackgroundColor3 = THEME.Void
		BarBack.BorderSizePixel = 0
		Instance.new("UICorner", BarBack).CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)

		local Fill = Instance.new("Frame", BarBack)
		Fill.Size = UDim2.fromScale(math.clamp((curVal - min) / (max - min), 0, 1), 1)
		Fill.BackgroundColor3 = THEME.Accent
		Fill.BorderSizePixel = 0
		Instance.new("UICorner", Fill).CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)

		local isDragging = false
		local function updateSlider(inp)
			local pct = math.clamp((inp.Position.X - BarBack.AbsolutePosition.X) / BarBack.AbsoluteSize.X, 0, 1)
			curVal = math.floor(min + ((max - min) * pct) + 0.5)
			Fill.Size = UDim2.fromScale(pct, 1)
			ValLbl.Text = tostring(curVal)
			pcall(callback, curVal)
		end

		BarBack.InputBegan:Connect(function(inp)
			if inp.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or inp.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
				isDragging = true
				updateSlider(inp)
			end
		end)
		UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(inp)
			if inp.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or inp.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then isDragging = false end
		end)
		UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(inp)
			if isDragging and (inp.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement or inp.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch) then
				updateSlider(inp)
			end
		end)
	end

	local function addNote(text)
		local Lbl = Instance.new("TextLabel", Page)
		Lbl.Size = UDim2.new(1, -8, 0, 20)
		Lbl.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		Lbl.Text = "- " .. text
		Lbl.TextColor3 = THEME.SubText
		Lbl.TextSize = 10
		Lbl.Font = Enum.Font.GothamMedium
		Lbl.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
		Lbl.TextWrapped = true
	end

	return {AddToggle = addToggle, AddButton = addButton, AddSlider = addSlider, AddNote = addNote}
end

-- Drawing FOV & Crosshair
local fovCircle, crosshairDot = nil, nil
if Drawing then
	fovCircle = Drawing.new("Circle")
	fovCircle.Thickness = 1.5
	fovCircle.NumSides = 40
	fovCircle.Radius = fovSize
	fovCircle.Color = THEME.Accent
	fovCircle.Transparency = 1
	fovCircle.Visible = false

	crosshairDot.Radius = 3
	crosshairDot.Filled = true
	crosshairDot.Color = THEME.Accent
	crosshairDot.Transparency = 1
	crosshairDot.Visible = false
end

local function isPartVisible(part)
	if not wallCheck then return true end
	local origin = Camera.CFrame.Position
	local dir = (part.Position - origin)
	local rayParams = RaycastParams.new()
	rayParams.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
	rayParams.FilterDescendantsInstances = {LocalPlayer.Character, Camera}
	local result = workspace:Raycast(origin, dir, rayParams)
	return (result == nil) or result.Instance:IsDescendantOf(part.Parent)
end

local function getAimTarget()
	local center = Vector2.new(Camera.ViewportSize.X / 2, Camera.ViewportSize.Y / 2)
	local target, shortest = nil, fovSize
	for _, p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
		if p ~= LocalPlayer and p.Character then
			if not teamCheck or (p.Team == nil or p.Team ~= LocalPlayer.Team) then
				local part = p.Character:FindFirstChild(aimPart)
				local hum = p.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
				if part and hum and hum.Health > 0 and isPartVisible(part) then
					local sPos, onScreen = Camera:WorldToViewportPoint(part.Position)
					if onScreen then
						local dist = (Vector2.new(sPos.X, sPos.Y) - center).Magnitude
						if dist < shortest then
							shortest = dist
							target = part
						end
					end
				end
			end
		end
	end
	return target
end

RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
	local screenCenter = Vector2.new(Camera.ViewportSize.X / 2, Camera.ViewportSize.Y / 2)
	
	if fovCircle then
		fovCircle.Position = screenCenter
		fovCircle.Radius = fovSize
		fovCircle.Visible = showFOV
	end

	if crosshairDot then
		crosshairDot.Position = screenCenter
		crosshairDot.Visible = showCrosshair
	end

	if steadyCam then
		-- Removes camera roll and vibration
		local look = Camera.CFrame.LookVector
		Camera.CFrame = CFrame.new(Camera.CFrame.Position, Camera.CFrame.Position + look)
	end

	if aimlock then
		local part = getAimTarget()
		if part then
			local aimPos = part.Position
			if predict and part.Parent and part.Parent:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") then
				local vel = part.Parent.HumanoidRootPart.AssemblyLinearVelocity
				aimPos = aimPos + (vel * (predictLead / 100))
			end
			local targetCFrame = CFrame.new(Camera.CFrame.Position, aimPos)
			Camera.CFrame = Camera.CFrame:Lerp(targetCFrame, 1 / smooth)
		end
	end
end)

TargetTab.AddNote("Select player to lock shadow follow, view or fling.")
local selectedTarget = nil
local loopShadow = false

local function getTargetPlayer()
	if selectedTarget and selectedTarget.Character and selectedTarget.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") then
		return selectedTarget
	end
	local myHrp = LocalPlayer.Character and LocalPlayer.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	if not myHrp then return nil end
	local nearP, sDist = nil, math.huge
	for _, p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
		if p ~= LocalPlayer and p.Character and p.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") then
			local d = (myHrp.Position - p.Character.HumanoidRootPart.Position).Magnitude
			if d < sDist then sDist = d nearP = p end
		end
	end
	return nearP
end

		local bav = Instance.new("BodyAngularVelocity", myHrp)

local tracerLines, skeletonLines = {}, {}
local function createLine()
	if Drawing then
		local l = Drawing.new("Line")
		l.Thickness = 1.5
		l.Color = THEME.Accent
		l.Transparency = 1
		l.Visible = false
		return l
	end
	return nil
end

local bonePairsR15 = {
	{"Head", "UpperTorso"}, {"UpperTorso", "LowerTorso"},
	{"UpperTorso", "LeftUpperArm"}, {"LeftUpperArm", "LeftLowerArm"}, {"LeftLowerArm", "LeftHand"},
	{"UpperTorso", "RightUpperArm"}, {"RightUpperArm", "RightLowerArm"}, {"RightLowerArm", "RightHand"},
	{"LowerTorso", "LeftUpperLeg"}, {"LeftUpperLeg", "LeftLowerLeg"}, {"LeftLowerLeg", "LeftFoot"},
	{"LowerTorso", "RightUpperLeg"}, {"RightUpperLeg", "RightLowerLeg"}, {"RightLowerLeg", "RightFoot"}
}
local bonePairsR6 = {
	{"Head", "Torso"}, {"Torso", "Left Arm"}, {"Torso", "Right Arm"},
	{"Torso", "Left Leg"}, {"Torso", "Right Leg"}
}

RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
	local bottomScreen = Vector2.new(Camera.ViewportSize.X / 2, Camera.ViewportSize.Y)
	for _, p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
		if p ~= LocalPlayer and p.Character then
			local char = p.Character
			local hrp = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
			local hum = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
			
			if Drawing then
				if not tracerLines[p] then tracerLines[p] = createLine() end
				local line = tracerLines[p]
				if tracersEnabled and hrp and hum and hum.Health > 0 then
					local pos, onScreen = Camera:WorldToViewportPoint(hrp.Position)
					if onScreen then
						line.From = bottomScreen
						line.To = Vector2.new(pos.X, pos.Y)
						line.Color = THEME.Accent
						line.Visible = true
					else line.Visible = false end
				else if line then line.Visible = false end end
			end

			if Drawing then
				if not skeletonLines[p] then
					skeletonLines[p] = {}
					for i = 1, 15 do table.insert(skeletonLines[p], createLine()) end
				end
				local bones = (char:FindFirstChild("UpperTorso") and bonePairsR15) or bonePairsR6
				local lines = skeletonLines[p]
				if skeletonEnabled and hum and hum.Health > 0 then
					for i, pair in ipairs(bones) do
						local p1 = char:FindFirstChild(pair[1])
						local p2 = char:FindFirstChild(pair[2])
						local l = lines[i]
						if p1 and p2 and l then
							local pos1, onScreen1 = Camera:WorldToViewportPoint(p1.Position)
							local pos2, onScreen2 = Camera:WorldToViewportPoint(p2.Position)
							if onScreen1 and onScreen2 then
								l.From = Vector2.new(pos1.X, pos1.Y)
								l.To = Vector2.new(pos2.X, pos2.Y)
								l.Color = THEME.Accent
								l.Visible = true
							else l.Visible = false end
						elseif l then l.Visible = false end
					end
				else for _, l in ipairs(lines) do l.Visible = false end end
			end
		else
			if tracerLines[p] then tracerLines[p].Visible = false end
			if skeletonLines[p] then for _, l in ipairs(skeletonLines[p]) do l.Visible = false end end
		end
	end
end)

local flying, flySpeed, flyBV, flyBG = false, 55, nil, nil
MoveTab.AddToggle("Smart Mobile Fly", false, function(v)
	flying = v
	local char = LocalPlayer.Character
	local hrp = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	if flying and hrp then
		flyBV = Instance.new("BodyVelocity", hrp)
		flyBV.MaxForce = Vector3.new(9e9, 9e9, 9e9)
		flyBV.Velocity = Vector3.zero
		flyBG = Instance.new("BodyGyro", hrp)
		flyBG.MaxTorque = Vector3.new(9e9, 9e9, 9e9)
		flyBG.CFrame = hrp.CFrame
		task.spawn(function()
			while flying and hrp.Parent and flyBV.Parent do
				local hum = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
				local moveDir = hum and hum.MoveDirection or Vector3.zero
				flyBG.CFrame = Camera.CFrame
				if moveDir.Magnitude > 0 then
					local flatLook = Vector3.new(Camera.CFrame.LookVector.X, 0, Camera.CFrame.LookVector.Z).Unit
					local flatRight = Vector3.new(Camera.CFrame.RightVector.X, 0, Camera.CFrame.RightVector.Z).Unit
					local fwd = moveDir:Dot(flatLook)
					local rgt = moveDir:Dot(flatRight)
					flyBV.Velocity = ((Camera.CFrame.LookVector * fwd) + (Camera.CFrame.RightVector * rgt)) * flySpeed
				else
					flyBV.Velocity = Vector3.zero
				end
				RunService.RenderStepped:Wait()
			end
		end)
	else
		if flyBV then flyBV:Destroy() end
		if flyBG then flyBG:Destroy() end
	end
end)

	end

-- Chat functions
local function getChannel()
	local channels = TextChatService:FindFirstChild("TextChannels")
	if channels then
		return channels:FindFirstChild("RBXGeneral")
	end
	return nil
end

local function buildMessage(targetName)
	local output = {}

	-- 1. Rotating Long Head Prefix
	table.insert(output, prefixes[prefixIndex])

	-- 2. Target Name Prefix if available
	if targetName ~= "" then
		table.insert(output, "[" .. targetName .. "]")
	end

	-- 3. Rotating Word
	table.insert(output, words[wordIndex])

	-- 4. Random Emoji
	local randomEmoji = emojis[math.random(1, #emojis)]
	table.insert(output, randomEmoji)

	-- Update indices for next message loop
	prefixIndex = prefixIndex + 1
	if prefixIndex > #prefixes then
		prefixIndex = 1
	end

	wordIndex = wordIndex + 1
	if wordIndex > #words then
		wordIndex = 1
	end

	return table.concat(output, " ")
end

local function sendMessage(text)
	local channel = getChannel()
	if channel then
		pcall(function()
			channel:SendAsync(text)
		end)
	else
		pcall(function()
			local events = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("DefaultChatSystemChatEvents")
			if events and events:FindFirstChild("SayMessageRequest") then
				events.SayMessageRequest:FireServer(text, "All")
			end
		end)
	end
end

	status.Text = "Status: RUNNING" .. (targetName ~= "" and " (Target: " .. targetName .. ")" or "")

	task.spawn(function()
		while running do
			local message = buildMessage(targetName)
			sendMessage(message)
			task.wait(customDelay)
		end
	end)
end)

	status.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 150, 150)
end)

local function applyStudAppearance(part)
	part.Size = Vector3.new(30, 30, 30)
	part.Anchored = true
	part.CanCollide = true
	part.Material = Enum.Material.Plastic
	part.Transparency = 0
	part.Color = Color3.fromRGB(163, 162, 165)
	part.TopSurface = Enum.SurfaceType.Studs
	part.BottomSurface = Enum.SurfaceType.Studs
	part.FrontSurface = Enum.SurfaceType.Studs
	part.BackSurface = Enum.SurfaceType.Studs
	part.LeftSurface = Enum.SurfaceType.Studs
	part.RightSurface = Enum.SurfaceType.Studs
end

local function getRoot(character)
	if not character then return nil end
	return character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") or character.PrimaryPart
end

local function syncFollowObjPosition(character)
	if not followObjEnabled then return end
	local activeChar = character or player.Character
	local root = getRoot(activeChar)
	if not root then return end

	if not followObjPart or not followObjPart.Parent then
		followObjPart = Instance.new("Part")
		followObjPart.Name = "TPWalkFollowObj"
		applyStudAppearance(followObjPart)
		followObjPart.Parent = Workspace
	end

	if followObjY == nil then
		followObjY = root.Position.Y - 3 - (followObjPart.Size.Y / 2)
	end

	followObjPart.Position = Vector3.new(root.Position.X, followObjY, root.Position.Z)
end

local function stopFollowObj()
	if followObjConnection then
		followObjConnection:Disconnect()
		followObjConnection = nil
	end
	if followObjPart then
		followObjPart:Destroy()
		followObjPart = nil
	end
	followObjY = nil
end

local function startFollowObj(character)
	stopFollowObj()
	if not followObjEnabled then return end

	local char = character or player.Character
	local root = getRoot(char) or (char and char:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart", 10))
	if not root or not followObjEnabled then return end

	followObjPart = Instance.new("Part")
	followObjPart.Name = "TPWalkFollowObj"
	applyStudAppearance(followObjPart)
	followObjPart.Parent = Workspace

	followObjY = root.Position.Y - 3 - (followObjPart.Size.Y / 2)
	followObjPart.Position = Vector3.new(root.Position.X, followObjY, root.Position.Z)

	followObjConnection = RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
		if not followObjEnabled then
			stopFollowObj()
			return
		end
		syncFollowObjPosition(player.Character)
	end)
end

local function getSafeDelta(character, humanoid, delta)
	local desired = humanoid.MoveDirection * (speed * STUDS_PER_VALUE) * delta
	if not antiNoclipped or desired.Magnitude == 0 then
		return desired
	end

	local root = getRoot(character)
	if not root then
		return desired
	end

	local params = RaycastParams.new()
	params.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
	params.FilterDescendantsInstances = { character, followObjPart }
	params.IgnoreWater = false

	local margin = 1.5
	local origins = {
		root.Position,
		root.Position + Vector3.new(0, 1.5, 0),
		root.Position - Vector3.new(0, 1.8, 0),
	}

	local maxAllowedDist = desired.Magnitude
	local dir = desired.Unit

	for _, origin in ipairs(origins) do
		local result = Workspace:Raycast(origin, dir * (maxAllowedDist + margin), params)
		if result and result.Instance and result.Instance.CanCollide then
			local safeDist = math.max(0, result.Distance - margin)
			if safeDist < maxAllowedDist then
				maxAllowedDist = safeDist
			end
		end
	end

	return dir * maxAllowedDist
end

local function disconnectLoop()
	if connection then
		connection:Disconnect()
		connection = nil
	end
end

local function attachToCharacter(character)
	disconnectLoop()
	if not tpwalking or not character then return end

	local humanoid = character:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("Humanoid") or character:WaitForChild("Humanoid", 10)
	if not humanoid or not tpwalking then return end

	connection = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(delta)
		if not tpwalking then
			disconnectLoop()
			return
		end

		if not character.Parent or not humanoid.Parent then
			disconnectLoop()
			return
		end

		if humanoid.MoveDirection.Magnitude > 0 then
			local stepVec = getSafeDelta(character, humanoid, delta)
			if stepVec.Magnitude > 0 then
				character:TranslateBy(stepVec)
				if followObjEnabled then
					syncFollowObjPosition(character)
				end
			end
		end
	end)
end

local isDraggingUI = false
do
	local dragInput = nil
	local dragStart = nil
	local startPos = nil
	local lockedCamCFrame = nil
	local camLockConn = nil

	local function lockCameraWhileDragging()
		camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
		if camera then
			lockedCamCFrame = camera.CFrame
		end
		if camLockConn then
			camLockConn:Disconnect()
			camLockConn = nil
		end
		camLockConn = RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
			if not isDraggingUI then
				if camLockConn then
					camLockConn:Disconnect()
					camLockConn = nil
				end
				return
			end
			camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
			if camera and lockedCamCFrame then
				camera.CFrame = lockedCamCFrame
			end
		end)
	end

	local function unlockCameraAfterDragging()
		isDraggingUI = false
		lockedCamCFrame = nil
		if camLockConn then
			camLockConn:Disconnect()
			camLockConn = nil
		end
	end

	local function updateDrag(input)
		local delta = input.Position - dragStart
		local targetPos = UDim2.new(
			startPos.X.Scale,
			startPos.X.Offset + delta.X,
			startPos.Y.Scale,
			startPos.Y.Offset + delta.Y
		)
		tween(mainFrame, TweenInfo.new(0.06, Enum.EasingStyle.Sine, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {
			Position = targetPos
		})
	end

	headerFrame.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
		if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
			isDraggingUI = true
			dragInput = input
			dragStart = input.Position
			startPos = mainFrame.Position
			lockCameraWhileDragging()

			input.Changed:Connect(function()
				if input.UserInputState == Enum.UserInputState.End then
					if dragInput == input then
						dragInput = nil
					end
					unlockCameraAfterDragging()
				end
			end)
		end
	end)

	headerFrame.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
		if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
			if isDraggingUI then
				dragInput = input
			end
		end
	end)

	UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
		if isDraggingUI and input == dragInput then
			updateDrag(input)
		end
	end)

	UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
		if isDraggingUI and (input == dragInput or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch) then
			unlockCameraAfterDragging()
		end
	end)
end

local function pushRadarEvent(text, isAlert)
	local row = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	row.Size = UDim2.new(1, -8, 0, 18)
	row.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	row.Text = " [" .. os.date("%X") .. "] " .. tostring(text)
	row.TextColor3 = isAlert and Theme.Danger or Theme.Success
	row.Font = Enum.Font.Code
	row.TextSize = 10
	row.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
	row.TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd
	row.Parent = radarFeedScroll

	task.wait()
	radarFeedScroll.CanvasSize = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, radarFeedLayout.AbsoluteContentSize.Y + 4)
	local targetY = math.max(0, radarFeedLayout.AbsoluteContentSize.Y - radarFeedScroll.AbsoluteSize.Y)
	tween(radarFeedScroll, TweenInfo.new(0.2, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {
		CanvasPosition = Vector2.new(0, targetY)
	})
end

local function refreshRadarBanner(reasonText)
	if kickDetected then
		radarTitleLabel.Text = "ALERT: System decided to kick you! Blocked."
		radarTitleLabel.TextColor3 = Theme.Danger
		radarBanner.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(58, 18, 26)
		tween(radarBannerStroke, TweenInfo.new(0.18), { Color = Theme.Danger, Thickness = 1.8 })
	else
		radarTitleLabel.Text = "Kick Detection: System has NOT decided to kick you"
		radarTitleLabel.TextColor3 = Theme.Success
		radarBanner.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(16, 44, 34)
		tween(radarBannerStroke, TweenInfo.new(0.18), { Color = Theme.Success, Thickness = 1.4 })
	end

	local autoText = autoBlockOnKick and "ON" or "OFF"
	local extra = reasonText and (" | " .. tostring(reasonText)) or ""
	radarDetailLabel.Text = string.format("Attempts: %d | Auto Block: %s%s", kickAttemptCount, autoText, extra)
end

local function switchTab(activeTabName)
	controlsPage.Visible = (activeTabName == "Controls")
	remotesPage.Visible = (activeTabName == "Remotes")
	kickRadarPage.Visible = (activeTabName == "KickRadar")
	logsPage.Visible = (activeTabName == "Logs")

	local activePage = controlsPage
	if activeTabName == "Remotes" then
		activePage = remotesPage
	elseif activeTabName == "KickRadar" then
		activePage = kickRadarPage
	elseif activeTabName == "Logs" then
		activePage = logsPage

local function parseSpeed(raw)
	if not raw then
		return 0.05
	end
	local cleaned = raw:gsub("%s+", ""):gsub("[sS]$", "")
	local val = tonumber(cleaned)
	if val == nil then
		return 0.05
	end
	if val < 0 then
		return 0
	end
	return val
end

local function parseArgument(raw)
	if raw == nil or raw == "" then
		return nil, false
	end
	local lower = raw:lower()
	if lower == "true" then
		return true, true
	elseif lower == "false" then
		return false, true
	end
	local num = tonumber(raw)
	if num ~= nil then
		return num, true
	end
	return raw, true
end

local function getTargetRemotes()
	local rawName = remoteNameTextBox.Text:match("^%s*(.-)%s*$")

	if rawName:upper() == "ALL EVENTS" then
		local eventsOnly = {}
		for _, r in ipairs(allRemotes) do
			if r:IsA("RemoteEvent") then
				table.insert(eventsOnly, r)
			end
		end
		if #eventsOnly > 0 then
			return eventsOnly
		end
		return allRemotes
	elseif rawName ~= "" then
		local lowerSearch = rawName:lower()
		local matches = {}
		for _, r in ipairs(allRemotes) do
			if r.Name:lower() == lowerSearch or r.Name:lower():find(lowerSearch, 1, true) then
				table.insert(matches, r)
			end
		end
		return matches
	elseif selectedRemote then
		return { selectedRemote }
	else
		return {}
	end
end

local savedPartSizes = {}
local savedMotorOffsets = {}
local savedHipHeight = nil
local savedBodyHeightScale = nil
local superTallConn = nil

local TALL_MULTIPLIER = 3.2

local function captureCharacterProportions(char, hum)
	table.clear(savedPartSizes)
	table.clear(savedMotorOffsets)
	savedHipHeight = nil
	savedBodyHeightScale = nil

	if hum then
		pcall(function()
			savedHipHeight = hum.HipHeight
		end)
		local hScale = hum:FindFirstChild("BodyHeightScale")
		if hScale and hScale:IsA("NumberValue") then
			savedBodyHeightScale = hScale.Value
		end
	end

	for _, desc in ipairs(char:GetDescendants()) do
		if desc:IsA("BasePart") then
			savedPartSizes[desc] = desc.Size
		elseif desc:IsA("Motor6D") then
			savedMotorOffsets[desc] = {
				C0 = desc.C0,
				C1 = desc.C1
			}
		end
	end
end

local function applyTallStretch(char, hum)
	if not char or not hum then
		return
	end

	local hScale = hum:FindFirstChild("BodyHeightScale")
	if hScale and hScale:IsA("NumberValue") then
		pcall(function()
			hScale.Value = (savedBodyHeightScale or 1) * TALL_MULTIPLIER
		end)
	end

	if savedHipHeight then
		pcall(function()
			hum.HipHeight = savedHipHeight * TALL_MULTIPLIER
		end)
	end

	for part, origSize in pairs(savedPartSizes) do
		if part and part.Parent and part.Name ~= "HumanoidRootPart" then
			pcall(function()
				part.Size = Vector3.new(origSize.X, origSize.Y * TALL_MULTIPLIER, origSize.Z)
			end)
		end
	end

	for motor, data in pairs(savedMotorOffsets) do
		if motor and motor.Parent then
			pcall(function()
				motor.C0 = CFrame.new(
					data.C0.Position.X,
					data.C0.Position.Y * TALL_MULTIPLIER,
					data.C0.Position.Z
				) * (data.C0 - data.C0.Position)
				motor.C1 = CFrame.new(
					data.C1.Position.X,
					data.C1.Position.Y * TALL_MULTIPLIER,
					data.C1.Position.Z
				) * (data.C1 - data.C1.Position)
			end)
		end
	end
end

local function restoreNormalProportions()
	local char = player.Character
	local hum = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")

	if hum then
		local hScale = hum:FindFirstChild("BodyHeightScale")
		if hScale and hScale:IsA("NumberValue") and savedBodyHeightScale then
			pcall(function()
				hScale.Value = savedBodyHeightScale
			end)
		end
		if savedHipHeight then
			pcall(function()
				hum.HipHeight = savedHipHeight
			end)
		end
	end

	for part, origSize in pairs(savedPartSizes) do
		if part and part.Parent then
			pcall(function()
				part.Size = origSize
			end)
		end
	end

	for motor, data in pairs(savedMotorOffsets) do
		if motor and motor.Parent then
			pcall(function()
				motor.C0 = data.C0
				motor.C1 = data.C1
			end)
		end
	end

	table.clear(savedPartSizes)
	table.clear(savedMotorOffsets)
	savedHipHeight = nil
	savedBodyHeightScale = nil
end

local function setSuperTallEnabled(enable)
	isSuperTallActive = enable

	if superTallConn then
		superTallConn:Disconnect()
		superTallConn = nil
	end

	if enable then
		local char = player.Character
		local hum = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
		if not char or not hum then
			isSuperTallActive = false
			pushLog("SUPER TALL: Character or Humanoid not found.", Theme.Danger)
			updateTelemetry()
			return
		end

		captureCharacterProportions(char, hum)
		applyTallStretch(char, hum)

		superTallConn = RunService.Stepped:Connect(function()
			if not isSuperTallActive then
				return
			end
			local curChar = player.Character
			local curHum = curChar and curChar:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
			if curChar and curHum then
				applyTallStretch(curChar, curHum)
			end
		end)

		superTallBtn.Text = "SUPER TALL: ON"
		superTallBtn.TextColor3 = Theme.TextPrimary
		tween(superTallBtn, TweenInfo.new(0.16), { BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(107, 33, 168) })
		pushLog("SUPER TALL enabled: character stretched tall.", Theme.Purple)
	else
		restoreNormalProportions()
		superTallBtn.Text = "SUPER TALL FE (Amination)"
		superTallBtn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(216, 180, 254)
		tween(superTallBtn, TweenInfo.new(0.16), { BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(46, 26, 78) })
		pushLog("SUPER TALL disabled: character restored.", Theme.TextSecondary)
	end

	updateTelemetry()
end

local function recordKickDecision(sourceDetail)

	kickAttemptCount += 1

	pushLog("KICK RADAR ALERT: " .. tostring(sourceDetail), Theme.Danger)

setJailbreaking = function(enable)
	isJailbreaking = enable

	if enable then
		hookedCount = 0
		local mt = nil
		pcall(function()
			if getrawmetatable then
				mt = getrawmetatable(game)
			end
		end)

		if mt and setreadonly then
			pcall(function()
				setreadonly(mt, false)
				if not originalNamecall and mt.__namecall then
					originalNamecall = mt.__namecall
					mt.__namecall = newcclosure and newcclosure(function(self, ...)
						local method = getnamecallmethod and getnamecallmethod() or ""
						if self == player and (method == "Kick" or method == "kick") then
							recordKickDecision("__namecall Kick")
							if isJailbreaking then
								return nil
							end
						end
						local lowerMethod = tostring(method):lower()
						if lowerMethod:find("ban") or lowerMethod:find("kick") or lowerMethod:find("anticheat") then
							recordKickDecision("Method: " .. tostring(method))
							if isJailbreaking then
								return nil
							end
						end
						return originalNamecall(self, ...)
					end) or function(self, ...)
						local method = getnamecallmethod and getnamecallmethod() or ""
						if self == player and (method == "Kick" or method == "kick") then
							recordKickDecision("__namecall Kick")
							if isJailbreaking then
								return nil
							end
						end
						return originalNamecall(self, ...)
					end
					hookedCount += 1
				end
				setreadonly(mt, true)
			end)
		end

		if hookfunction and player and player.Kick then
			pcall(function()
				if not originalKick then
					originalKick = hookfunction(player.Kick, function(...)
						recordKickDecision("Direct Kick Hook")
						if isJailbreaking then
							return nil
						end
						return originalKick(...)
					end)
					hookedCount += 1
				end
			end)
		end

		hookActive = true
		jailbreakBtn.Text = "JAILBREAK ACTIVE"
		jailbreakBtn.TextColor3 = Theme.TextPrimary
		tween(jailbreakBtn, TweenInfo.new(0.16), { BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(4, 120, 87) })
		tween(mainStroke, TweenInfo.new(0.22), { Color = Theme.Emerald, Thickness = 2 })
		pushLog("Jailbreaking enabled | Hooks installed: " .. tostring(hookedCount), Theme.Emerald)
	else
		hookActive = false
		jailbreakBtn.Text = "Jailbreaking"
		jailbreakBtn.TextColor3 = Theme.TextPrimary
		tween(jailbreakBtn, TweenInfo.new(0.16), { BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(16, 56, 46) })
		tween(mainStroke, TweenInfo.new(0.22), { Color = Theme.Accent, Thickness = 1.5 })
		pushLog("Jailbreaking paused/disabled.", Theme.TextSecondary)
	end

	refreshRadarBanner()
	updateTelemetry()
end

local function triggerAdminAbuseEvents()
	if #allRemotes == 0 then
		table.clear(allRemotes)
		for _, root in ipairs({ ReplicatedStorage, workspace }) do
			for _, desc in ipairs(root:GetDescendants()) do
				if desc:IsA("RemoteEvent") or desc:IsA("RemoteFunction") then
					table.insert(allRemotes, desc)
				end
			end
		end
	end

	table.clear(adminAbuseEvents)
	local abuseKeywords = { "admin", "abuse", "cmd", "command", "ban", "kick", "announce", "event", "weather", "gravity", "speed", "jump", "nuke", "spawn", "kill", "tp", "teleport", "god", "heal", "money", "cash", "give" }

	for _, rem in ipairs(allRemotes) do
		local lower = rem.Name:lower()
		for _, kw in ipairs(abuseKeywords) do
			if lower:find(kw, 1, true) then
				table.insert(adminAbuseEvents, rem)
				break
			end
		end
	end

	if #adminAbuseEvents == 0 then
		for i = 1, math.min(#allRemotes, 12) do
			table.insert(adminAbuseEvents, allRemotes[i])
		end
	end

	rebuildAbuseEventRows()

	local argVal, hasArg = parseArgument(argBox.Text)
	local triggered = 0
	for _, rem in ipairs(adminAbuseEvents) do
		pcall(function()
			if rem:IsA("RemoteEvent") then
				if hasArg then
					rem:FireServer(argVal)
				else
					rem:FireServer()
				end
				fireCount += 1
				triggered += 1
			elseif rem:IsA("RemoteFunction") then
				task.spawn(function()
					pcall(function()
						if hasArg then
							rem:InvokeServer(argVal)
						else
							rem:InvokeServer()
						end
						fireCount += 1
					end)
				end)
				triggered += 1
			end
		end)
	end

	pushLog("ADMIN ABUSE drew " .. tostring(#adminAbuseEvents) .. " real events & fired " .. tostring(triggered) .. ".", Theme.Rose)
	updateTelemetry()
end

local function fetchAdminPanel()
	local keywords = { "admin", "panel", "event", "draw", "mod", "cmd", "command", "host", "owner", "spawn", "gui" }
	local foundCount = 0
	local clonedCount = 0

	local playerGui = player:FindFirstChildOfClass("PlayerGui")
	local searchContainers = { ReplicatedStorage, StarterGui, workspace }
	if playerGui then
		table.insert(searchContainers, playerGui)
	end

	local function matchesKeyword(objName)
		local lower = objName:lower()
		for _, kw in ipairs(keywords) do
			if lower:find(kw, 1, true) then
				return true
			end
		end
		return false
	end

	for _, container in ipairs(searchContainers) do
		for _, desc in ipairs(container:GetDescendants()) do
			if (desc:IsA("ScreenGui") or desc:IsA("Frame")) and matchesKeyword(desc.Name) then
				foundCount += 1
				if desc:IsA("ScreenGui") then
					desc.Enabled = true
					if playerGui and not desc:IsDescendantOf(playerGui) then
						pcall(function()
							local copy = desc:Clone()
							copy.Enabled = true
							copy.Parent = playerGui
							clonedCount += 1
						end)
					end
				elseif desc:IsA("Frame") then
					desc.Visible = true
					local parentGui = desc:FindFirstAncestorOfClass("ScreenGui")
					if parentGui then
						parentGui.Enabled = true
					end
				end
			end
		end
	end

	if foundCount > 0 then
		statusText.Text = "Admin Panel found (" .. tostring(foundCount) .. ") | Cloned: " .. tostring(clonedCount)
		pushLog("Admin/Event GUI items found: " .. tostring(foundCount) .. " (Cloned: " .. tostring(clonedCount) .. ")", Theme.Amber)
	else
		statusText.Text = "No admin event GUI found in client containers."
		pushLog("No matching Admin/Event GUI found.", Theme.Danger)
	end
end

local function fireTargetsOnce()
	local targets = getTargetRemotes()
	if #targets == 0 then
		pushLog("No target remote found.", Theme.Danger)
		updateTelemetry()
		return
	end

	local argValue, hasArg = parseArgument(argBox.Text)
	for _, rem in ipairs(targets) do
		pcall(function()
			if rem:IsA("RemoteEvent") then
				if hasArg then
					rem:FireServer(argValue)
				else
					rem:FireServer()
				end
				fireCount += 1
			elseif rem:IsA("RemoteFunction") then
				if hasArg then
					rem:InvokeServer(argValue)
				else
					rem:InvokeServer()
				end
				fireCount += 1
			end
		end)
	end

	pushLog("Fired " .. tostring(#targets) .. " target(s) | Total: " .. tostring(fireCount), Theme.TextPrimary)
	updateTelemetry()
end

	local dOk, data = pcall(function()
		return HttpService:JSONDecode(raw)
	end)
	if not dOk or type(data) ~= "table" then
		return
	end

	if type(data.headSize) == "number" then
		headSize = math.clamp(math.round(data.headSize), 1, 100)
	end
	if type(data.hitboxEnabled) == "boolean" then
		hitboxEnabled = data.hitboxEnabled
	end
	if type(data.autoHitboxEnabled) == "boolean" then
		autoHitboxEnabled = data.autoHitboxEnabled
	end
	if data.hitboxPartMode == "Head" or data.hitboxPartMode == "Torso" then
		hitboxPartMode = data.hitboxPartMode
	end
	if data.hitboxApplyMode == "ALL" or data.hitboxApplyMode == "ONE" then
		hitboxApplyMode = data.hitboxApplyMode
	end
	if type(data.selectedNpcLabel) == "string" and data.selectedNpcLabel ~= "" then
		selectedNpcLabel = data.selectedNpcLabel
	end
	if type(data.espEnabled) == "boolean" then
		espEnabled = data.espEnabled
	end
	if type(data.healthEspEnabled) == "boolean" then
		healthEspEnabled = data.healthEspEnabled
	end
	if type(data.nameEspEnabled) == "boolean" then
		nameEspEnabled = data.nameEspEnabled
	end
	if type(data.distEspEnabled) == "boolean" then
		distEspEnabled = data.distEspEnabled
	end
	if data.espColorMode == "PART" or data.espColorMode == "HP" then
		espColorMode = data.espColorMode
	end
	if type(data.accentIdx) == "number" and accentPresets[data.accentIdx] then
		accentIdx = data.accentIdx
	end
	if type(data.bgIdx) == "number" and bgPresets[data.bgIdx] then
		bgIdx = data.bgIdx
	end
	if type(data.transIdx) == "number" and transparencySteps[data.transIdx] ~= nil then
		transIdx = data.transIdx
	end
	if type(data.cornerIdx) == "number" and cornerSteps[data.cornerIdx] ~= nil then
		cornerIdx = data.cornerIdx
	end
	if type(data.guiSizeIdx) == "number" and guiSizeSteps[data.guiSizeIdx] ~= nil then
		guiSizeIdx = data.guiSizeIdx
	end

	uiTheme.Accent = accentPresets[accentIdx].color
	uiTheme.Background = bgPresets[bgIdx].bg
	uiTheme.ButtonOff = bgPresets[bgIdx].btn
	uiTheme.Transparency = transparencySteps[transIdx]
	uiTheme.CornerPx = cornerSteps[cornerIdx]
	uiTheme.GuiScale = guiSizeSteps[guiSizeIdx]
end

		transIdx = transIdx,
		cornerIdx = cornerIdx,

	}

	local eOk, encoded = pcall(function()
		return HttpService:JSONEncode(payload)
	end)
	if not eOk or type(encoded) ~= "string" then

local function getNpcDisplayName(model, hum)
	local attr = model and model:GetAttribute("DisplayName")
	if type(attr) == "string" and attr ~= "" then
		return attr
	end
	if hum and type(hum.DisplayName) == "string" and hum.DisplayName ~= "" then
		return hum.DisplayName
	end
	return model and model.Name or "NPC"
end

local function getNpcBodyPartColor(model, head, root)
	local candidate = nil
	if model then
		candidate = model:FindFirstChild("Torso") or model:FindFirstChild("UpperTorso")
	end
	if not (candidate and candidate:IsA("BasePart")) then
		candidate = head
	end
	if not (candidate and candidate:IsA("BasePart")) and root and root:IsA("BasePart") then
		candidate = root
	end

	if candidate and candidate:IsA("BasePart") then
		local col = candidate.Color
		local maxC = math.max(col.R, col.G, col.B)
		local minC = math.min(col.R, col.G, col.B)
		if maxC > 0.14 and not (minC > 0.88 and (maxC - minC) < 0.08) then
			return col
		end
	end
	return nil
end

local function getNpcEspColor(model, head, root, ratio)
	local hpColor = Color3.fromRGB(255, 0, 50):Lerp(Color3.fromRGB(0, 255, 100), ratio)
	if espColorMode == "PART" then
		local partColor = getNpcBodyPartColor(model, head, root)
		if partColor then
			return partColor
		end
	end
	return hpColor
end

local function getNpcMinMaxHealth(model, hum)
	local minHp = 0
	local maxHp = hum and tonumber(hum.MaxHealth) or 100

	local aMin = model and tonumber(model:GetAttribute("MinHealth"))
	local aMax = model and tonumber(model:GetAttribute("MaxHealth"))
	local vMin = model and (model:FindFirstChild("MinHealth") or (hum and hum:FindFirstChild("MinHealth")))
	local vMax = model and (model:FindFirstChild("MaxHealth") or (hum and hum:FindFirstChild("MaxHealth")))

	if aMin ~= nil then
		minHp = aMin
	elseif vMin and (vMin:IsA("NumberValue") or vMin:IsA("IntValue")) then
		minHp = vMin.Value
	end

	if aMax ~= nil then
		maxHp = aMax
	elseif vMax and (vMax:IsA("NumberValue") or vMax:IsA("IntValue")) then
		maxHp = vMax.Value
	end

	if not maxHp or maxHp <= minHp then
		maxHp = minHp + 1
	end

	local attrHp = model and tonumber(model:GetAttribute("Health"))
	local curHp = attrHp ~= nil and attrHp or (hum and tonumber(hum.Health) or minHp)
	curHp = math.clamp(curHp, minHp, maxHp)

	return curHp, minHp, maxHp
end

	local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera

local function restorePart(part)
	local saved = originalParts[part]
	if saved and part and part.Parent then
		pcall(function()
			part.Size = saved.Size
			part.Transparency = saved.Transparency
			part.CanCollide = saved.CanCollide
			part.Massless = saved.Massless
		end)
	end
	originalParts[part] = nil
end

local function restoreAllParts()
	for part in pairs(originalParts) do
		restorePart(part)
	end
end

local function getNPCs()
	local npcs = {}
	local counts = {}
	for _, obj in ipairs(workspace:GetDescendants()) do
		if obj:IsA("Model") and not Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(obj) then
			local hum = obj:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
			local head = obj:FindFirstChild("Head")
			local root = obj:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
			if hum and head and head:IsA("BasePart") and root and root:IsA("BasePart") and not root.Anchored then
				local baseName = getNpcDisplayName(obj, hum)
				counts[baseName] = (counts[baseName] or 0) + 1
				local label = counts[baseName] > 1 and (baseName .. " #" .. tostring(counts[baseName])) or baseName
				table.insert(npcs, { model = obj, hum = hum, head = head, root = root, label = label })
			end
		end
	end
	return npcs
end

local elapsed = 0
RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(dt)
	elapsed += dt
	if elapsed < 0.25 then
		return
	end
	elapsed = 0

	local targetSize = Vector3.new(headSize, headSize, headSize)
	local refPos = getReferencePosition()
	local npcs = getNPCs()
	npcList = npcs

	if hitboxApplyMode == "ONE" and #npcList > 0 then
		local found = false
		for _, item in ipairs(npcList) do
			if item.label == selectedNpcLabel then
				found = true
				break
			end
		end
		if not found then
			selectedNpcLabel = npcList[1].label
		end
	end
	syncTargetButtonLabel()

	if NpcListFrame.Visible then
		rebuildNpcListButtons()
	end

	local canApply = hitboxEnabled and autoHitboxEnabled
	local activeParts = {}

	for _, npc in ipairs(npcs) do
		local model, hum, head, root = npc.model, npc.hum, npc.head, npc.root
		local targetPart = getHitboxPart(model, head)
		local matchesTarget = (hitboxApplyMode == "ALL") or (npc.label == selectedNpcLabel)

		if canApply and matchesTarget and hum.Health > 0 and targetPart then
			activeParts[targetPart] = true
			if not originalParts[targetPart] then
				originalParts[targetPart] = {
					Size = targetPart.Size,
					Transparency = targetPart.Transparency,
					CanCollide = targetPart.CanCollide,
					Massless = targetPart.Massless,
				}
			end
			if targetPart.Size ~= targetSize then
				pcall(function()
					targetPart.Size = targetSize
					targetPart.Transparency = 0.6
					targetPart.CanCollide = false
					targetPart.Massless = true
				end)
			end
		end

		local hl = model:FindFirstChild("ESP_Highlight")
		if espEnabled then
			pcall(function()
				if not hl then
					hl = Instance.new("Highlight")
					hl.Name = "ESP_Highlight"
					hl.OutlineColor = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
					hl.Parent = model
				end
				hl.FillColor = hum.Health <= 0 and Color3.fromRGB(255, 0, 0) or Color3.fromRGB(0, 255, 0)
			end)
		elseif hl then
			hl:Destroy()
		end

		local hpGui = model:FindFirstChild("NPC_Health_ESP")
		if healthEspEnabled then
			pcall(function()
				updateHealthBillboard(model, hum, head, root, refPos)
			end)
		elseif hpGui then
			hpGui:Destroy()
		end

		local infoGui = model:FindFirstChild("NPC_Info_ESP")
		if nameEspEnabled or distEspEnabled then
			pcall(function()
				updateNameAndDist(model, hum, head, root, refPos)
			end)
		elseif infoGui then
			infoGui:Destroy()
		end
	end

	for part in pairs(originalParts) do
		if not activeParts[part] then
			restorePart(part)
		end
	end
end)

syncTargetButtonLabel()
applyThemeToAll()
